description: List papers in an arXiv category — the same listings as the category pages' "new" / "recent" views and monthly archives (arxiv.org/list/{category}/new etc.). period=new returns today's listing in three groups (new submissions, cross-lists, replacements, with inline abstracts); period=recent returns the past week's submissions grouped by day; period=month returns a monthly archive of papers submitted in that month (use --month, e.g. 2026-07; sourced from the Atom API with precise submission timestamps and abstracts). Returns paper cards with arXiv ID, title, authors, categories, date, abstract (where the source provides it), and abs/PDF links. Each call is a single request; respects arXiv's >=3s request-spacing etiquette at the caller level. No authentication required.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: arXiv category ID, e.g. "cs.AI", "cs.LG", "astro-ph.CO", "hep-th". Required. Case-sensitive: the archive part is lowercase and the subcategory suffix is uppercase ("cs.ai" is invalid). ~155 valid values exist; run arxiv/list-categories to enumerate them, or copy the ID from any category page URL (arxiv.org/list/{category}/new).

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: Listing type. Allowed values: new = today's new/cross/replacement submissions, split into three sections with inline abstracts (default); recent = the past week, grouped by day (title-only cards, no abstracts); month = a monthly archive of papers submitted in that month, newest first (requires --month).

parameters.name: month
parameters.description: Archive month in YYYY-MM format (e.g. "2026-07"), defaults to the previous month. Only used when period=month.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of papers to return, 1-200 (default 50). For period=new the limit applies per section (new/cross/replacements each return up to limit). When a listing is exhausted (fewer than limit available), partial=true is returned.
